data.narrative:
Destinus is a late-stage frontier-tech company in the Defense & Security sector, having raised $400M+ to date. The valuation universe comprises 10 comparable companies: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable and yields a $480M valuation by applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier to the $400M raised proxy, reflecting typical markup from late-stage to next-stage funding. Peer-median analysis was not viable; while 23 same-sector peers exist, insufficient clustering within narrow stage/valuation-tier filters prevented reliable comparative multiples. Peer-set constraints (0 same-stage, 2 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier matches) meant that broadening to all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable sectoral noise.

Analysis supports a valuation range of $408M–$552M, centered on $480M, derived exclusively from stage-progression. The range bounds reflect standard ±15% variance around the median estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of publicly disclosed contemporaneous financials for tight peer comparison and the nascent maturity of frontier-defense valuations generally. A more refined range would require either disclosure of revenue/profitability metrics or closer comparables at identical stage and valuation tier.
